before: paragraphByNodeId listed every body paragraph and its text on each call.
after: paragraphByNodeId reads a node-id map built once per body tree by the paraId address walk, then that one paragraph's text; paragraphByStableId drops a hint when a store change may give its id a new first claimant.
reason: The map applies the same paraId normalization as the paragraph snapshot, so every lookup returns the same paragraph, id, and text; shared state, operations, and serialization are unchanged.
